cause: The scheduler-off probe defaulted to force_materialized=true. Real M1 serving and the first device A/B use the monolithic arm. The materialized baseline also has a different full-K BF16 boundary, so its output hash cannot serve as the scheduler closure reference.
correction: Rerun scheduler-off with --mode monolithic, require identical payload hashes and cross-arm output hashes, and retain the original candidate per-K128 ordered BF16 boundary.
